summary: Southeast Asia super-app (rides, food delivery, fintech). Turned GAAP-profitable in 2025; growing ~20% with margins expanding; large net cash.

rationale.growthHigh: Revenue growth ~20% now (deliveries, mobility, lending); ~17% average over 5 years.
rationale.targetMargin: Uber's operating margin is heading to mid-teens; Grab follows with lower prices in its markets.
rationale.marginConvergenceYear: Margin expansion is gradual, reaching target around year 6.
rationale.exitMultiple: 28x: still growing double digits in year 5, similar to Uber/DoorDash on forward earnings.

thesis.text: Grab is Southeast Asia's leading super-app across rides, food delivery and digital banking. It is now profitable and growing ~20%, with a large net cash pile.
bull: Dominant market share in most SEA markets
Fintech/lending scaling on its own user base
bear: Regulatory and labour-cost risk across many countries
watch: Adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow growth

changes.text: First Claude base case and thesis.
